'''Nchumbulu''' or '''Nchummuru''' is a [[Guang language]] of [[Ghana]].<ref>Ansah, M. A., & Agyeman, N. A. (2015). Ghana language-in-education policy: The survival of two South Guan minority dialects. In: ''Per Linguam'' 31(1), 89.</ref>
It is spoken in parts of [[Bono East Region|Bono East]], [[Oti Region|Oti]], Northern and [[Savannah Region|Savannah regions.]]<ref>Batibo, Herman ''Language Decline and Death in Africa: Causes, Consequences, and Challenges'' (2005)</ref><ref name=e25/>
